name: polymarket-paper-lab
description: Quantitative paper trading lab for Polymarket sports markets

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w database && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend --if-present && npm run lint -w frontend --if-present
